note: Illinois DNR fish and wildlife area near Astoria on Anderson Lake, a shallow Illinois River floodplain lake. Two primitive campgrounds: North, along the Anderson Lake shore, and South, beside Carlson Lake, a waterfowl area drained each early summer. River overflow floods the area at times; the DNR asks visitors to call the site office before a trip. --Claude
summary: DNR camp + park pages, the brochure and its map, closures page, 2027 fee schedule, ExploreMoreIL place list; Esri z18/z19. Lakefront KEPT for the North Campground (east leg of the loop runs along the shore, pull-ins 10-25 m from the water over open grass; no site numbers published). $11 kept (Class C); electric 0, dump confirmed. South Camp limited by flooding. Phone 217-782-6302 -> 309-759-4484. Count 100 / max 64 unsourced. Pin ~230 m from the North loop.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront KEPT (checked hard; not --AWH). The brochure's North Campground is the elongated loop between Route 100 and the Anderson Lake shore, ~40.1944-40.1967,-90.2025 to -90.2032. On leaf-on z19 imagery its east leg is a gravel road running along the riprapped shoreline with pull-ins at ~40.1960,-90.2027 and ~40.1952,-90.2029, 10-25 m from open water over mown grass with scattered single trees - no tree wall. No site numbers are published (no site map; not on ExploreMoreIL), so sites can't be named; all sites are sold by the night (FCFS permits). South Campground (~40.1927,-90.2054) faces Carlson Lake, which the park page says is 'drained in early summer' - it doesn't earn the value.
